text:
sophia_support: Customer (acme-payments) reports a spike of 5xx / timeouts hitting their hosted endpoints since ~08:12 UTC. They see lots of request "tail" timeouts, p95/p99 shot up.

omar_oncall: got it, can you paste the exact request IDs and sample logs?

sophia_support: sending sample IDs: rq_01F8X2A3, rq_01F8X2B7, rq_01F8X2D0. Customer says 504s after 10s. They repro with 1 req/s sustained but long sequences.

lee_runtime: ingress-bot just fired a queue-depth alert for hosted-ingress pool boston-1: "queue_depth > 9500" at 08:09. Could be continuous-batching backlog.

ingress-bot: ALERT: hosted-ingress-boston-1 queue_depth=9734 p95_latency=2.1s p99_latency=6.3s dropped_requests=42

natalie_incidents: any config changes or deploys in the last hour?

omar_oncall: no deploys. We rolled a smaller kernel tweak earlier but that was >24h. Looks like sudden tenant spike + longsequences causing kvcache pressure.

lee_runtime: logs for rq_01F8X2A3: "enqueue_time=08:11:15, dequeue_time=08:11:26, processing_start=08:11:26, timeout=10s -> 504". Continuous batcher backlog pushed dequeue delay >10s.

sophia_support: customer_ops: can you share workload? they said they switched from short prompts to long multi-shot chat.

customer_ops: yes we started a bulk migration, many long sequences (~2k tokens). Rate kept at ~1-2 r/s. We didn't expect queueing.

omar_oncall: repro notes: longseqs increase KV cache eviction + bigger batch construction time. Batcher waits to fill, leading to long tail. For hosted we have queue depth limit default 10k; once close, latency spikes.

lee_runtime: quick mitigations: 1) reduce max_seq_length via model params; 2) lower batching window for that tenant; 3) route tenant to higher priority pool (dedicated) or smaller batcher.

natalie_incidents: Sophia, escalate to sales/solutions to discuss dedicated burst capacity for them? They hit production customers.

sophia_support: done. I shared runbook steps with customer: lower concurrency, shorten prompts, or use streaming to avoid timeouts. Also opened a support ticket to allow temporary soft-limit bump.

omar_oncall: config change applied: lowered batcher_max_wait_ms from 30 -> 10 for tenant acme-payments in hosted-ingress-boston-1 at 08:28. Monitoring now.

ingress-bot: INFO: config-change tenant=acme-payments batcher_max_wait_ms=10 applied by omar_oncall

lee_runtime: after change queue_depth dropped to ~4300 and p99 fell from 6.3s -> 1.9s within 5m. Still watching for deferred KV pressure.

customer_ops: after lowering window latency is back to normal for us, thank you. We'll also throttle longseq jobs and spin off migration into smaller batches.

natalie_incidents: follow-up action items: - propose dedicated burst plan - add tenant-specific alert for continuous-batch backlog - doc for customers on long-seq best practices.

omar_oncall: adding runbook note: when continuous-batching backlog shows queue_depth>8000 and p99>5s, temporarily reduce batching window or route to higher priority pool.

sophia_support: closing customer-facing loop. Will update ticket when sales confirms plan. :thumbsup:
